messages.content: One of the outlets in my kitchen sparked when I plugged in the toaster.

Safety first: stay away from it and don't touch the outlet or anything plugged in. If you can reach your breaker panel safely (not standing in water), switch off that circuit. If you see flames or the smoke gets worse, get out and call 911.

Thanks for letting me know. Is the problem limited to that one outlet, or have you noticed anything odd with other outlets or in other parts of the house?
Just that one outlet, the rest of the kitchen works.
Got it, thanks. Besides the spark when you plugged in the toaster, have you noticed any burning smell, or does the outlet feel hot or look scorched?
Just the one spark. The outlet isn't hot.
Thanks, that helps. What's your zip code so I can find pros near you?
Thanks, we cover Davis. So a pro can contact you, what's your name and the best phone number to reach you? Email works too if you'd rather.
